description: Deterministically generate a brand-new German E-Rechnung (ZUGFeRD 2.5 PDF/A-3b or KoSIT XRechnung 3.0.2 XML) from structured JSON (<300ms, exact BigDecimal math & MOD-97 IBAN verification). Use when creating an invoice from structured JSON without an existing PDF; use embed_zugferd_pdf if you already have a visual PDF, or magic_convert_pdf if you only have an unstructured PDF. Returns JSON containing format, filename, mimeType, and either xml (UTF-8 CII XML) or pdfBase64 (Base64 PDF/A-3b).

format.description: Output document format: 'ZUGFERD' renders a human-readable PDF/A-3b with embedded factur-x.xml; 'XRECHNUNG' returns pure UN/CEFACT CII XML.

invoice.description: Structured German B2B invoice payload conforming to EN 16931 / XRechnung 3.0 / ZUGFeRD 2.5.

buyer.description: Buyer / customer legal entity, postal address, VAT ID, and electronic endpoint (BG-7).

countryCode.description: Buyer ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code (BT-55), e.g. DE.

email.description: Buyer electronic address email (BT-49; mandatory on XRECHNUNG per PEPPOL-EN16931-R010).

street.description: Buyer street name and house number (BT-50).

vatId.description: Buyer VAT ID (BT-48; mandatory for 0% Reverse Charge AE or Intra-EU K).

buyerReference.description: Leitweg-ID or buyer PO reference (BT-10; mandatory when profile is XRECHNUNG per BR-DE-15).

deliveryDate.description: Service or delivery date in ISO YYYY-MM-DD format (BT-72).

dueDate.description: Payment due date in ISO YYYY-MM-DD format (BT-9).

grossTotal.description: Optional total gross payable amount including VAT (BT-112); verified against netTotal + vatTotal.

issueDate.description: Invoice issue date in ISO YYYY-MM-DD format (BT-2).

items.description: Non-empty list of invoice line items (BG-25).
Single invoice line item with net unit price, quantity, and VAT rate.

lineTotalNet.description: Optional net line total (BT-131); verified against quantity * unitPriceNet within 0.02 EUR.

taxCategoryCode.description: Optional EN 16931 VAT category code (BT-151): S, AE, K, E, G, Z, or O; auto-inferred when omitted.

taxExemptionReason.description: Optional 0% VAT exemption reason text (BT-120), e.g. § 19 UStG Kleinunternehmer.

unit.description: Human unit or UN/ECE Rec 20 code (BT-130), e.g. Stk, Std, Tage, pauschal, kg, piece, hour.

vatPercent.description: Applicable German VAT rate percentage (BT-152), typically 19, 7, or 0.

netTotal.description: Optional total net invoice amount excluding VAT (BT-109); verified against sum of line items.

paymentTermsDescription.description: Human-readable payment terms or skonto text (BT-20; required if dueDate is omitted).

seller.description: Seller / supplier legal entity, postal address, tax identifiers, contact point, and SEPA bank account (BG-4).

bankDetails.description: Seller SEPA bank accounts for wire transfer and EPC GiroCode QR generation (BG-17).

items.description: SEPA credit transfer bank account entry.

accountHolder.description: Optional account holder name (BT-85); defaults to seller.name.

iban.description: SEPA IBAN passing ISO 13616 MOD-97 checksum (BT-84).

countryCode.description: Seller ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code (BT-40), e.g. DE.

email.description: Seller contact & electronic endpoint email (BT-43 / BT-34; mandatory on XRECHNUNG per BR-DE-7 and PEPPOL-EN16931-R020).

phone.description: Seller contact phone number with at least 3 digits (BT-42; mandatory on XRECHNUNG per BR-DE-6).

street.description: Seller street name and house number (BT-35).

taxNumber.description: Seller local German tax number / Steuernummer (BT-32).

vatId.description: Seller VAT ID / USt-IdNr. with country prefix (BT-31), e.g. DE123456789.

vatTotal.description: Optional total VAT amount (BT-110); verified against VAT category breakdown.

profile.description: Compliance profile: 'EN16931' for standard German B2B invoices (DATEV ZUGFeRD 2.5 Comfort), or 'XRECHNUNG' for strict KoSIT XRechnung 3.0.2 public-sector rules (requires buyerReference, seller email/phone, buyer email).

stampGiroCode.description: When true, stamps a scannable EPC SEPA GiroCode QR code onto the visual ZUGFeRD PDF using seller.bankDetails[0].iban.

name: generate_erechnung
